# Slay Kallio — Side-view Concept Pack v0.1

This package groups the existing TURF material that becomes useful once the new project is allowed to use a horizontal side-view camera.

## Included in the repo package

- two TURF cast contact sheets for identity context
- eight near-profile TURF attack frames that were invalid for TURF's isometric-facing rules
- a package manifest and production notes

## Additional library source pool

The parallel downloadable archive also contains nine prior TURF-related side-view/profile concept sheets from the art library: explicit side-walk, four-direction, side-angled combat, white-suit profile walk, Alepa profile and broader character rosters.

## Status

Concept/reference only. Do not treat any file here as final Slay Kallio production art.

## First production lock

Before rebuilding sprites, define one horizontal camera, common character height, floor baseline, left/right facing convention and animation scale. Then use this pack to select identities and motion ideas.
